panel.title: Workflow
panel.description: Set up the run's inputs, then review its layers, statistics and exports.

aoi.description: Choose the area the indicator is computed over.

productivity.description: How vegetation productivity is measured, and how a decline in it is detected. The sensors decide the analysis resolution and which years have data. The VI threshold zeroes out index values at or below it — Terra NPP is the one sensor that ignores it.

lceu_value.calculate: Calculate based on land cover and soil texture

land_cover.description: Where land cover comes from, and which pixels are treated as water. ESA CCI runs from 1992 to 2022, and years outside that range are clamped to it. Custom assets need two-digit class codes (10–99) that the transition matrix recognises.
land_cover.water_mask_other_arm: A different water mask is already configured; this control only edits the seasonality threshold.

soc.description: The window soil organic carbon change is measured over. It inherits the assessment period unless you override it here. An end year past 2022 is clamped to the end of the CCI land cover record, and a start year before 1992 is reported rather than silently moved.

run.description: The years the whole indicator is measured over. Every sub-indicator is derived from it, and land cover and soil organic carbon can override it in their own section, so set this one first. The line under the two years shows what the sensors you picked actually cover.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Draw any computed layer on the map, clipped to your area of interest.
layers.add_failed: Could not add {name} to the map: {reason}

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.description: How much land moved between each pair of land cover classes over the assessment period. Rows are the class a pixel started in, columns the class it ended in, and each value is an area. This is the transition matrix the land cover sub-indicator is derived from.

results.title: Distribution
results.description: Area of each degradation class — degraded, stable, improved — broken down by land cover type. This is how the indicator is usually reported: it shows which land cover types the degradation in your area is concentrated in.

zonal.title: Zonal statistics
zonal.description: Indicator areas summed inside each feature of your area of interest, one row per zone. Download it as a shapefile to join the figures back to your own boundaries in QGIS, or to report per-district totals.

period_override.toggle: Use a different period for this sub-indicator

nav.locked_params: Select an area of interest first.
nav.locked_results: Fill in every required parameter first.

matrix.description: Each cell reads as a change from the row's land cover class to the column's, and sets whether the indicator counts that change as degradation, stable or improvement. It starts from the default IPCC matrix; click a cell to cycle its value, or reset to restore them all.
matrix.title: Transition matrix
